==Dialogue==
;Default
:''"Hello! I am Brother Sitai, and I tend the Shrine of Maat. You must be here to make an offering. I will leave you to it."''

;When hexed
:''"Hungry...so hungry...arrrrrghh!"''

;During [[The Shrine of Maat]]
:''"That...that creature! It was as if a blanket of night enveloped us...smothered us. Some were consumed before they could even scream. Few escaped. I prayed beneath the shrine that I would be spared. My pleas were answered and the beast did not see me as I fled."''
